messages:
Jorge: Kicking off Cumulus reserved pool bring-up. Need a quick sync on quota gating, autoscale knobs, and a smokeload tomorrow 09:00 PT. Posting checklist + proposed ramp.
Priya: Got it. Can we confirm target QPS and warm KV cache plan?
Jorge: Target steady QPS 1200, bursts to 3k for 5m. Cache warm plan: prefix-warm on /v1/generate for top-50 clients.
Ari: I'll own client enablement comms. Any SLA flags we should surface?
Devon: FYI autoscaler policy currently: scale_up 2 min windows, scale_down 15m. That might be too slow for spikes.
Linh: Suggest adding a short-term "emergency burst" policy that bypasses cooldown for the first 10m post-priming.
Jorge: Agree. Devon, can you make a temporary policy: cooldown_override=true, max_burst=2x for 15m? Also set quota guard at 90% of pool.
Devon: On it. Pushing change to staging now, will link PR.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: autoscale-policy/feature/burst-override -> staging at commit 3a4f9b
Priya: For load test script, using vegeta. Paste targets and ramp plan:
```
# targets: /v1/generate
stage1: 100qps 5m
stage2: ramp to 1200qps over 10m
stage3: spike to 3000qps 5m
```
Jorge: We'll run a dry run in staging today at 16:30 PT. Need SRE + CS on call. Devon, Ari, Linh please.
Ari: I'm available for 16:30. I'll prep customer-facing note to Cumulus.
Devon: 16:30 ok. Will collect platform metrics and KV hit ratios.
Linh: I'll run the warm prefixes script 30m before test.
Priya: After dry run, capture perf regression checklist: p50/p95/p99, error rates, queue depth, tokens/sec, host OOMs. I can assemble templates.
Jorge: Perfect. If dry run passes, we aim for production smoke tomorrow 09:00 PT. If fail, we rollback policy and re-evaluate.
Ari: One ask from Cumulus—can we limit debug logs to warn+ so they don't get noisy during test?
Devon: Will flip log level to warn for the test window. Noting retained logs in console.
Priya: Uploading loadscript to shared drive: drive.redwood/cumulus/loadtests/stage1.targets
Jorge: Thanks team. Quick owners: run=Devon, warming=Linh, comms=Ari, postmortem=Priya. Ping here with results. :rocket:
Devon: Dry run complete — staging hit target ramp, small error spike at 2.9k qps (12% 5xx). Captured traces and started a trace dump.
Jorge: Copy. Postmortem after we digest traces. Great work. :thumbsup:
